finalText:
Perfect! The build is now clean. The error was on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it referenced `retries` as an undefined variable instead of `env.retries`. 

The fix: changed `maxRetries: retries` to `maxRetries: env.retries || 1`, so it properly pulls the retry value from the environment object passed to the function.

The build now finishes with **3 warnings, 0 errors** (exit code 0). The three warnings about deprecated APIs and unused exports remain, but those are safe to ignore—the real blocking error is gone.
